name: bk_exp21_continuation
title: Whether the continuation changes does not predict what Oracle Lens exhibits
caption: Exp 21 (exploratory, post hoc): a bag-of-tokens classifier on the true next n tokens of the source, grouped 5-fold by file. Left: Spearman between that AUROC and Oracle Lens's exhibition (exp 20's reconstructor AUROC) across rows; only 4 tokens over the 7 readable rows is positive (+0.54, n = 7, not significant), the 9-row +0.78 is carried by the two unreadable Markdown rows. Right: at 4 tokens every readable row is separable (0.85 to 0.97), yet the lens exhibits the Python string at 0.91 and the table column at 0.64. Table column's continuation is synthetic (regenerated from exp 13's cell pools). No CIs: per-row AUROCs only, n = 7 to 9 rows.
